inj.note: Sweat was diagnosed with a knee injury during the Jets' Week 7 loss to the Dolphins. The initial diagnosis was week-to-week, and the Jets medical staff has determined that a stint on IR is warranted for the third-year defensive lineman, although he's expected to return this season. Sweat will be required to miss at least four games, so the earliest he can play is Week 12 against the Dolphins on Sunday, Nov. 29, although he could be held out until after the Jets' Week 13 bye. Darrell Jackson and Harrison Phillips will both step into more prominent roles on the defensive line in Sweat's absence.

news.h: T'Vondre Sweat placed on injured reserve with knee injury
news.d: The Jets will be without T'Vondre Sweat for at least the next four games, as the starting nose tackle was placed on injured reserve Saturday with a knee sprain.
